Perfect Short Term Rental Investment - Great Returns!

Web Ref. CBC-RS00131
Floor size 42.00 m²
Monthly Bond Repayment
R16,962.47
A fantastic investment opportunity in the sought-after 1 on Albert development in Woodstock. This well-positioned two-bedroom, one-bathroom apartment offers a smart combination of modern living, convenience and exceptional short-term rental potential.
The apartment is designed for easy, low-maintenance living, with a contemporary kitchen, comfortable living space, two bedrooms with built-in cupboards and a well-appointed bathroom. Large window in main bedroom brings in plenty of natural light, creating a bright and inviting feel. The second bedroom has a skylight.
What really sets this property apart is its short-term rental earning potential. 1 on Albert has established itself as one of the strongest-performing developments in the area for short-term accommodation, with exceptional demand from visitors wanting easy access to Woodstock, the CBD, the V&A Waterfront and surrounding attractions. Returns can be particularly impressive during the summer and peak tourism periods.
For investors looking for a property that can generate strong rental income while offering an affordable entry point into the Cape Town property market, this is a seriously compelling opportunity.
A genuine investment property with the potential to deliver some of the best short-term rental returns in the area — a no-brainer for the savvy investor.

Monthly Rates R500
